ModMetaData.name: Ra2Bunker Endpoint LOS Fix V5.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5.4063 LOS fix for Ra2Bunker. V5.1 keeps the original 0.75 fill, makes Ra2_Bunker opaque through the vanilla Building CanBeSeenOver authority, and grants a temporary exception only while the bunker itself is acquiring a target or is the actual caster/target of a combat check. Outside-to-outside sight and fire through the bunker remain blocked.
